mira: Pushed a draft PR for the Troubleshooting -> 429s & timeouts section: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 
mira: Goal is to cover: Retry-After handling, exponential backoff samples (Python/TS), when we fallback to lower-capacity model, and a short migration note for teams moving from self-hosted endpoints. Can someone eyeball the examples? :eyes:
alex: Taking a look now. Quick thought: call out the difference between transient 429s (burst) and sustained capacity-driven 429s. We should recommend request-level vs. route-level throttling strategies.
mira: Good point. I added a note but it reads dense. Maybe a tiny table or bullet list would be clearer.
sam: For the SDK snippets we should show both automatic retry and a manual example. Our Python SDK already does retries for idempotent calls, but users need manual backoff for streaming/generation. Suggest this snippet for manual retry (add to PR):
```python
import time
from redwood import RedwoodClient, RedwoodError
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")

def generate_with_retry(prompt):
    backoff = 1.0
    for attempt in range(5):
        try:
            return client.generate(prompt)
        except RedwoodError as e:
            if e.code == 429:
                retry_after = int(e.headers.get("Retry-After", 0))
                wait = max(retry_after, backoff)
                time.sleep(wait)
                backoff *= 2
            else:
                raise
    raise RuntimeError("max retries exceeded")
```
kevin: Nice. Also include a TS/JS example showing exponential backoff + AbortController for timeouts. Many users copy-paste.
kevin: Eg: `const ac = new AbortController(); setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), 10_000);` then pass `signal: ac.signal` to SDK call.
mira: Added both snippets. Also added a short note about 429 headers: `Retry-After` (seconds) and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (unix). Is that accurate?
alex: Yes. Also mention we sometimes return `Retry-After: 0` for immediate retry candidates (very short bursts) vs. >0 for scheduled retries.
sam: On fallback behavior: we should be explicit about when the platform will route to a compatible fallback model vs. returning 429. Proposed text: "If capacity constrained, Redwood may route to a compatible, lower-cost model variant when policy allows; otherwise requests will receive 429 with Retry-After." Put that under "Expected behavior".
mira: OK added. Need validation from runtime team that phrasing is safe for public docs. @kevin can you confirm?
kevin: Confirmed. That's the customer-facing phrasing we agreed on in the last runbook sync.
docs-bot: Reminder: please add a changelog entry under `docs/changes/` if this affects examples or behaviour notes.
mira: Good call. I'll add an entry. Also need a migration blurb: teams using older SDKs relied on automatic truncation of long contexts — we now prefer explicit `truncate` parameter and we panic with 413 if > model max. Draft: "Older SDKs silently truncated; new behavior returns 413 and recommends client-side truncation or windowing. See SDK snippet." Thoughts?
alex: Definitely document that prominently. Many infra teams will hit 413s during migration. Add sample token-checker code and link to `console -> model limits` page.
mira: Added token-checker and internal link to console docs (placeholder to be converted before merge).
sam: Also add FAQ item: "What if my app can't handle partial responses when we fallback?" Answer: recommend `response_mode=buffered` or application-level queuing and test with canary traffic.
kevin: One more: include a quick diagnostics checklist for ops: check `requests_per_minute` in Console, look for `429` spikes, check `allocation`/Dedicated pool usage, trace id. Might be useful as an ordered list.
mira: Done. Formatting question: do we want a small callout code block showing `curl` semantics for Retry-After handling? e.g.:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-70b", "input":"..."}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# look for 'Retry-After' header in response and obey seconds
```
kevin: Yes please. Also mention the `x-rw-fallback` response header we add when a fallback was used.
mira: I added that header note. Anything else before I ask for editorial review?
alex: Link-check: you referenced `sdk.retry.enable` config but file path is wrong. It should be `sdk.config.retry.enable`. Fix that.
mira: Fixed. Also added a tiny test-case in `docs/tests/` that asserts the Retry-After header is documented.
sam: LGTM from examples standpoint. I'd like a follow-up task to add a small generated YAML for the migration guide for customers using on-prem Dedicated.
mira: Filed TODO: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/799
kevin: Approve once the runtime confirmation is in the PR description and the link to console is real.
mira: Will do. Thanks y'all :heart:
